counting_rule: One CPU user_annotation execute_context event = one scheduler step
limitations: PIECEWISE graph launches and GPU annotation fragments are not scheduler steps.
Prompt request counts include scheduled chunks, not necessarily distinct requests; sample IDs and request IDs remain in the separate request metadata.
CPU annotation spans measure host execution scopes, not GPU latency or utilization.
Optional GPU spans join by External id and event name and union overlapping annotations; envelopes include gaps and are not summed kernel time or SM utilization.

Client phases use adjacent wall/monotonic clock samples and profiler timestamps. They distinguish ongoing admissions from final drain, not a verified steady state; client in-flight counts include queueing and codec work.
Whole-run averages include initial fill and final drain. A single-wave trace cannot characterize sustained continuous batching.
Profiler overhead changes timings; this analysis is not acceptance evidence.
